ideas.idea: Expand thin content on home, varieties and visit pages so they can be cited or ranked
ideas.why: Rests on word-count folklore; the deliberate choices say short pages are not a problem.

ideas.idea: Create per-variety pages at /varieties/[slug] with flavour, use, pollination group and season, and add them to the sitemap
ideas.why: The varieties page names over forty varieties with no detail pages, so individual pages give concrete findable facts.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/LocalBusiness, Product and openingHoursSpecification JSON-LD
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add address, hours of day, directions, parking and contact details to the Visit page, since its description promises opening times and directions
ideas.why: The description says 'Opening times and directions' but the body lacks them, which is a real mismatch in this repo.

ideas.idea: Add a title template and default title, openGraph, twitter card and default image in layout metadata
ideas.why: The layout only sets metadataBase, but these defaults are standard advice with modest effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot and Bytespider as Disallow groups in robots.txt
ideas.why: The policy is trainingCrawlers: block, yet only GPTBot and ClaudeBot are blocked, so other training crawlers are still allowed.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow groups for OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User and PerplexityBot
ideas.why: They are already allowed through the wildcard, so explicit groups only guard against future edits.

ideas.idea: Replace the static sitemap with app/sitemap.ts that includes lastmod
ideas.why: With three static URLs, lastmod has little effect, and generating from variety data only matters if the variety pages are added.

ideas.idea: Use a distinctive brand name and sameAs links because 'Orchard' is generic
ideas.why: Entity-resolution advice that is plausible but speculative, and sameAs depends on JSON-LD that is not required.

ideas.idea: Remove the /account robots Disallow so crawlers can read the noindex if it is ever linked
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say noindex plus Disallow on /account is correct for a private page.

ideas.idea: Use next/link instead of plain <a> tags in the nav
ideas.why: The report itself says this is not an SEO issue, and it only affects client-side navigation.

ideas.idea: Make canonical URLs relative since metadataBase is set
ideas.why: This is a minor code-tidiness change with no effect on discovery.
